decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement, PL1 001, PL1 002, PL1 010, PL1 012, PL1 013 Rev A, PL1 040 Rev A, PL1 070 Rev A, PL1 110 Rev C, PL1 112 Rev C, PL1 113 Rev B, PL1 140 Rev B, and PL1 170 Rev B received: 13 June 2017. PL1 071 Rev B and PL1 171 Rev D received 26 July 2017. PL1 011 Rev B and PL1 111 Rev D received: 8 August 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the commencement of use of the rear raised patio platform, details of boundary treatment to the western boundary with 279 Popes Lane shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include the design, materials, and type of boundary treatment to be erected. The boundary treatment shall be installed in accordance with the approved details and thereafter maintained and retained as such.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension incorporating conversion of a garage into habitable room, a single storey rear extension with raised rear platform, and a side and rear roof extension incorporating front and side roof windows to the house
